featureLines: WyreStorm provides solutions for today’s demanding LECTURING spaces.

The SW-640L-TX-W is an advanced wireless presentation and conferencing system, tailored to meet the dynamic requirements of modern meeting spaces and conference rooms. This upgraded model boasts significant enhancements. Key improvements include two USB-C inputs with 60W PD, now featuring Multi Stream Transport (MST) support to unlock advanced connectivity and multi-display workflows. The switcher also includes an upgraded USB 3.0 switcher, further enriched by the support for a wireless host through the APO-DG2/APO-DG2-PRO. This addition allows for more flexible and convenient connections.
Display up to 4 source devices at the same time via Multiview feature, creating a supportive environment for collaboration between colleagues and teams.
A built-in USB 3.0 hub on the switcher allows local connection of peripherals devices such as a conference speakerphone.
Supports input resolutions up to 4K30 4:4:4 via USB-C or HDMI
Supports “Wireless Infrastructure” mode which allows APO-DG2, APO-DG2-PRO and Apple Airplay to work with third party wireless access points
Analog audio output allows extraction of Audio
Compatible with all major conference software including Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Cisco WebEx and more
Compatible with mainstream audio DSPs and video bars, including brands such as Q-SYS, Shure, Biamp, Extron, Yealink, Logitech and more. For details, please refer to the USB compatibility list.
Compatible with Microsoft Teams Rooms(MTR), like Lenovo ThinkSmart Core Gen 1/2 devices.
USB-C input supports alt-mode for both A/V (MST Supported), Ethernet, and Data communication over a single cable
Integrated webserver for control, setup and live monitoring via HTTPS
Easily mountable under a table or desk with included mounting brackets
Wireless access point supports custom SSID, password and screensharing access PIN
Integrated ‘Guide Screen’ with simple instructions to get connected can be modified with custom image
Supported file types: jpg, jpeg, png, txt, pdf, doc, docx

governedSpecification.productType: 4-input 4K wireless presentation & conferencing switcher with dual HDMI matrix outputs, USB 3.0 hub and 60W USB-C

ports.detail: Alt-mode A/V with MST, Ethernet + data, 60W PD, up to 4K@30Hz

dependencies: Wireless casting via APO-DG2/APO-DG2-PRO requires the dongle (sold separately), or use AirPlay/Miracast
60W USB-C PD is for host device charging
checks: Inputs and HDMI Out 2 are HDCP 1.4 only; only HDMI Out 1 is HDCP 2.2. A protected 4K source needing HDCP 2.2 will not pass, and the two outputs are not equivalent.
Input resolution is capped at 4K@30Hz (USB-C and HDMI). HDMI Out 1 reaches 4K@60Hz; Out 2 is 4K@30Hz.
Assignable USB host with a built-in USB 3.0 hub - confirm which host owns the peripherals.
warnings: Easy to mis-sell as a 4K60 switcher: only HDMI Out 1 reaches 4K60/HDCP 2.2; inputs and Out 2 are 4K30 and HDCP 1.4.
Microsoft Teams Rooms compatibility is claimed on the page (compatible, not certified) - confirm certification for a Teams deployment.
